subject: PrimeBridge implementation immersion track
messages:
From: Kelsey Hart <kelsey.hart@primebridge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: PrimeBridge Implementation <impl@primebridge.com>
Date: 2028-10-01T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Immersive implementation track for PrimeBridge

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. PrimeBridge’s delivery org would like to run a short, intensive implementation "immersion" for our systems integrator partners so they can confidently deliver Redwood-powered features to our enterprise customers.

High-level ask: can Redwood run a 2-week immersion for our top three SI partners that covers architecture, deployment patterns (hosted vs private), security controls, and hands-on runbooks for model routing and cost tuning?

Goals we care about:
- Reduce time-to-first-delivery for SIs from 6 weeks -> 3 weeks
- Ensure consistent observability/SLI setup across deployments
- Provide an actionable checklist for procurement and compliance handoffs

Constraints/notes:
- Prefer an on-site week 1 (NYC) and remote week 2 for deep labs, but happy to flex.
- We will loop in our procurement and security leads if we hit deliverables that require SOW changes.

Can you share a proposed agenda, required prerequisites for the SI engineers, and any standard artifacts (onboarding matrix, sample configs, SOW template)? Also pls highlight which Redwood roles should attend (SEs, solutions architects, partner ops).

Appreciate it — Kelsey

--
Kelsey Hart
Director, Partner Programs | PrimeBridge

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Kelsey Hart <kelsey.hart@primebridge.com>
Cc: PrimeBridge Implementation <impl@primebridge.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-01T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Immersive implementation track for PrimeBridge

Hi Kelsey,

Love this — we can run a focused immersion that aligns with your goals. Draft plan below and I attached two starter artifacts (primebridge_onboarding_matrix.xlsx, redwood-sample-config.yaml) for the SI prep checklist.

Suggested format (2 weeks):
Week 1 (onsite, NYC) — Foundations & architecture
- Day 1: Executive alignment + runbooks overview
- Day 2: Architecture deep dive (hosting modes, routing policies)
- Day 3: Security & compliance workshop (audit logs, KMS/HSM integration)
- Day 4: Observability & SLO design (cost + latency dashboards)
- Day 5: Joint lab prep + kickoff for week 2

Week 2 (remote) — Hands-on labs & partner handoff
- Day 6–8: Guided labs (deployment, KV cache tuning, batching)
- Day 9: Quality/eval session (prompt sets, regression checks)
- Day 10: Handoff: SOW checklist, procurement items, and next-step rollouts

Who from Redwood to include:
- SE lead (Sean Gallagher) for architecture and labs
- Partner ops (Naomi) for program coordination
- Solutions architect (Diego Fernandez) for security/ops deep dives

Prerequisites for SI engineers:
- Read: onboarding matrix (attached)
- Access: sandbox cluster and service account (we'll generate short-lived creds)
- Baseline: at least one proof-of-concept using a small open model

I'll open a doc for the agenda and link the SOW template. If that timeline works, we can lock the week of Oct 16 for onsite.

Thanks — Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partner Enablement | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Kelsey Hart <kelsey.hart@primebridge.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Immersive implementation track for PrimeBridge

Naomi — thanks for the draft. Adding a few technical details we should include in the agenda and the prep doc (quick bullets below).

On Mon, Oct 1, 2028 at 10:20 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Love this — we can run a focused immersion that aligns with your goals. Draft plan below and I attached two starter artifacts (primebridge_onboarding_matrix.xlsx, redwood-sample-config.yaml) for the SI prep checklist.

Proposed technical additions:
- Pre-lab checklist: capture typical token distribution and latency targets so we can pre-select quantization profiles and batching windows
- Lab 1: End-to-end deploy (model catalog pick, kernel selection, autoscaling policy) with a sample load generator
- Lab 2: Cost diagnostics (token-level billing breakdown + caching impact) — bring a PrimeBridge sample prompt set
- IRL failover scenario: simulate region outage and show smart routing + fallback to compatible variants

Operational ask for PrimeBridge procurement:
- Confirm data residency requirements for the pilot (NYC vs multi-region)
- Provide preferred DocuSign contact for SOW sign-off

I'll take lead on the lab runbook and provide the load generator repo link in the shared drive. Diego: can you draft the security agenda for Day 3?

—Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com

From: Kelsey Hart <kelsey.hart@primebridge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: PrimeBridge Implementation <impl@primebridge.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-03T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Immersive implementation track for PrimeBridge

Perfect — this is exactly what we had in mind.

Quick updates from our side:
- SOW: I've attached PB-SOW-v1.pdf for your legal and delivery review (see attachment).
- Procurement: DocuSign contact is contracts@primebridge.com; please route the finalized SOW there.
- Data residency: Pilot should be US-only; we will confirm regions during the alignment call.

Next steps:
1) Naomi — please share the agenda doc and calendar hold for Oct 16–27 (onsite week + remote labs).
2) Sean — share the lab runbook and load generator link when ready.
3) Diego — security agenda draft for Day 3.

Thanks all — Kelsey

Attachment: PB-SOW-v1.pdf (SOW draft, 12 pages, application/pdf)

--
